schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE INSURANCE (
    PID INT,
    TIV_2015 NUMERIC,
    TIV_2016 NUMERIC,
    LAT NUMERIC,
    LON NUMERIC,
    PRIMARY KEY (PID),
    CHECK (TIV_2015 >= 0),
    CHECK (TIV_2016 >= 0)
);
q1: SELECT ROUND(SUM(TIV_2016),2) TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE WHERE TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) AND (LAT,LON) IN (SELECT LAT,LON FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY LAT,LON HAVING COUNT(*)=1)
q2: SELECT ROUND(SUM(TIV_2016), 2) AS TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE WHERE TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015 HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ) AND (LAT, LON) NOT IN (SELECT LAT, LON FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY LAT, LON HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(TIV_2016),2) TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE WHERE TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) AND (LAT,LON) IN (SELECT LAT,LON FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY LAT,LON HAVING COUNT(*)=1)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(TIV_2016), 2) AS TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE WHERE TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015 HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ) AND (LAT, LON) NOT IN (SELECT LAT, LON FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY LAT, LON HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
counterexample: INSERT INTO INSURANCE (PID, TIV_2015, TIV_2016, LAT, LON) VALUES (1, 1000, 1500, 40.7128, -74.0060); INSERT INTO INSURANCE (PID, TIV_2015, TIV_2016, LAT, LON) VALUES (2, 1000, 1200, 34.0522, -118.2437); INSERT INTO INSURANCE (PID, TIV_2015, TIV_2016, LAT, LON) VALUES (3, 1200, 1800, 40.7128, -74.0060);
explanation: Q1 selects policies that have the same TIV_2015 value as at least one other policy AND are located at a unique latitude and longitude. Q2 selects policies that have the same TIV_2015 value as at least one other policy AND are NOT located at a latitude and longitude that is shared by at least two policies.
counterexample_dsp: A test database with 3 policies, where policy 1 and policy 2 share the same TIV_2015 value and are located at unique latitude and longitude, while policy 3 has a different TIV_2015 value and is located at the same latitude and longitude as policy 1.
